audit.whatIsWrong: Level chart claimed Zaahen wins every row, while the whys for rows 0, 1 and 4 describe an even farm phase and a level-6 skill-check. The packet levelChart reads Skill/Skill/Zaahen/Zaahen/Skill/Zaahen/Zaahen.
audit.why: Mel is a 550-range control mage with no dash; Zaahen has no gap-closer threat online until E and the Q recast at 3, and level 6 adds Solar Snare (E) root plus Rebuttal (W) damage immunity against his 110s Grim Deliverance.
audit.corrected: Rows 0, 1 and 4 set to Skill in both layers (phases[N].side and win[N] proposed as matched pairs).

audit.whatIsWrong: Spike text named non-existent abilities: 'Q Darkin Glaive', 'E Golden Onslaught', 'R Final Retribution', 'passive Rebalance marks', and called Solar Snare her R.
audit.why: Riot kit data: Mel is Searing Brilliance (P, Overwhelm + execute), Radiant Volley (Q), Rebuttal (W), Solar Snare (E), Golden Eclipse (R). Zaahen's W is Dreaded Return and R is Grim Deliverance (confirmed via mirror audit); Q and E have no name in the kit file so they are referred to by slot.
audit.corrected: All four spikes plus early/mid/late rewritten on real names and real slots; Golden Eclipse identified as the global Overwhelm detonation, not a root.

audit.whatIsWrong: Text claimed Rebuttal 'reflects your engage damage back onto you' and warned against dashing into it. Rebuttal reflects projectiles; against Zaahen the load-bearing part is that it prevents her taking damage at all. Also the Searing Brilliance execute threshold and the ability-cast auto-attack wind-up were never mentioned.
audit.why: Zaahen's kit has no projectile — Q is an on-hit double slash, W a 850-range stab-and-pull, E a dash. Nothing of his gets reflected; what actually happens is his whole burst is blanked for the barrier's duration. Rebuttal is 38s at rank 1, so the window after it is spent is the real engage. Searing Brilliance executes off accumulated Overwhelm, which is an HP number the bar does not show.
audit.corrected: Rewrote the W lines as damage immunity, added the 38s / 11s cooldowns, added the Overwhelm execute and the extra-projectile auto wind-up as the step-back cue.

audit.whatIsWrong: No cooldown numbers anywhere in the matchup.
audit.why: Solar Snare 11/10.5/10/9.5/9, Rebuttal 38/35/33/29/26, Radiant Volley 10/9/8/7/6, Golden Eclipse 120/100/80.
audit.corrected: Added 11s and 38s to breakdown.cooldowns, report[5].t, dosFull[0].d and spikes[1].text.

audit.whatIsWrong: Golden Eclipse's global reach was never stated.
audit.why: Golden Eclipse has 25000 range and strikes every Overwhelm-marked enemy regardless of distance — it kills a low-HP Zaahen in the side lane with Mel nowhere near.

edits.before: You dominate here against a squishy control mage. Mel wants to stack her passive Rebalance marks and poke with Q Radiant Volley, but she's paper-thin and immobile, so your Q Darkin Glaive and E Golden Onslaught let you walk her down and burst her before her poke matters. Force the all-in the moment she steps up to CS.
edits.after: You dominate here against a squishy control mage. Mel stacks Searing Brilliance (P) Overwhelm and pokes with Radiant Volley (Q), but she is paper-thin and immobile, so your E dash closes and your Q recast knocks her up before her poke matters. Force the all-in the moment she steps up to CS.

edits.before: Mel's R Solar Snare is a wide-area root, and her W Solar Snare/Overwhelm reflect can turn a mistimed dash back on you — but she has no dash and no real escape, so if you dodge or eat the CC and commit R Final Retribution, she dies. Bait her W reflect window, then engage; don't ult her while W is active.
edits.after: Solar Snare (E) is her root, up every 11s at rank 1, and Rebuttal (W) makes her damage-immune while it holds — but she has no dash, so dodge the root, wait the barrier out, then commit Grim Deliverance (R). Never ult into an active Rebuttal; the gap after it is your engage.

edits.before: Even into two items Mel can't escape you in the side lane — she has no mobility and folds to your sustained damage the instant you're on top of her. Respect her R root as gank bait and her W reflect on your engage, but one-on-one you delete her every time you get in range.
edits.after: Even into two items Mel can't escape you in the side lane — she has no mobility and folds to your sustained damage the instant you're on top of her. Golden Eclipse (R) reaches you anywhere on the map through Overwhelm stacks, so never sit low in the side lane.

edits.before: Levels 1-2 are an even farm phase — Mel pokes with Q Radiant Volley and builds her passive marks, but she's too squishy and immobile to punish you hard yet, so nothing is decided. Set up your level-3 spike and don't eat free poke standing in her Q.
edits.after: Levels 1-2 are an even farm phase — Mel pokes with Radiant Volley (Q) and stacks Overwhelm, but she is too squishy and immobile to punish you hard yet, so nothing is decided. Every ability she casts loads projectiles onto her next auto: that wind-up is your cue to step back.

edits.before: From level 3 you take over: your Q Darkin Glaive and E Golden Onslaught let you close on a mobility-less control mage and burst her before her poke ramps, and that edge carries through level 5. Level 6 is a skill-check only because her R Solar Snare and W reflect can flip a careless engage, so bait the reflect and dodge the root, then commit.
edits.after: From level 3 you take over: your E dash and Q knockup recast let you close on a mobility-less control mage and burst her before her poke ramps, and that edge carries through level 5. Level 6 is a skill-check because Solar Snare (E) roots on 11s and Rebuttal (W) blanks damage outright, so dodge the root, wait the 38s barrier out, then commit.

edits.before: Into items you keep crushing her — your durability and Q sustain shrug off her mana-hungry poke while she has no escape from your sustained damage, which is why this sits at a commanding 58% win rate. Respect her R as gank bait and don't ult into her W reflect, but any time you're in range one-on-one she dies.
edits.after: Into items you keep crushing her — your durability and Q sustain shrug off her mana-hungry poke while she has no escape from your sustained damage, which is why this sits at a commanding 58% win rate. Overwhelm executes off a hidden threshold, so track the HP number, not the bar, and never ult into Rebuttal.
